section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch23 — Indian & AP Geography
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The Deccan Plateau, which covers most of peninsular India including Andhra Pradesh, is bounded by the Western Ghats on one side and which range on the other?

options.option_text: Vindhya Range (as northern boundary, not eastern)

explanation: The Deccan Plateau is flanked by the Western Ghats (west) and Eastern Ghats (east), with the Vindhya-Satpura ranges marking its northern edge, not its eastern boundary.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch23 — Indian & AP Geography
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Coastal Andhra Pradesh receives a significant share of its annual rainfall from which monsoon, unlike most of North India which depends mainly on the South-West monsoon?
explanation: The Tamil Nadu and southern coastal Andhra region receive substantial rain from the retreating/North-East monsoon (Oct–Dec) as it picks up moisture crossing the Bay of Bengal — unlike the North-West, dependent on western disturbances.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch23 — Indian & AP Geography
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Which Indian river forms a large delta before entering the Bay of Bengal near Andhra Pradesh's coast and is often called the 'Ganga of the South'?
explanation: The Godavari, India's second-longest river, is popularly called 'Dakshina Ganga' (Ganga of the South) and forms a major delta in coastal Andhra. Narmada and Tapi flow west into the Arabian Sea; the Mahanadi is in Odisha/Chhattisgarh.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch25 — Economy, Budget & Schemes
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The body that replaced the Planning Commission in India in 2015, tasked with policy formulation through cooperative federalism rather than centralised planning, is:
explanation: NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) replaced the Planning Commission in January 2015, acting as a policy think-tank rather than an allocator of five-year-plan funds. The Finance Commission deals with Centre-State tax devolution, a separate constitutional body.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch25 — Economy, Budget & Schemes
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The rate at which the Reserve Bank of India lends short-term funds to commercial banks is called the:
explanation: Repo rate is the rate at which RBI lends to banks against securities. Reverse repo is the reverse — RBI borrowing from banks. SLR is the proportion of deposits banks must hold in liquid assets, not a lending rate.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch25 — Economy, Budget & Schemes
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The scheme guaranteeing at least 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households is popularly known by its acronym:
explanation: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act guarantees 100 days of wage employment to rural households. PMAY is a housing scheme, PMGSY a rural roads scheme, and NRHM a health mission.
